item.text: The starter already has a shared SQLite opener, so I’m building on that and adding a durable jobs schema plus a worker heartbeat. The worker will persist retry scheduling and recover any `running` job to `queued` on restart, which keeps crashes within the same three-attempt limit.
The API and worker are in place. I’m adding the polling form and list now, then I’ll compile and run the smoke and contract checks to catch any interface or SQLite issues.

item.text:
Implemented the SQLite-backed job API, separate worker with heartbeat, retries and restart recovery, and a browser page that submits and polls jobs.

`npm run build` passes, and the worker starts and shuts down cleanly. The smoke and contract checks could not run because the environment rejected loopback binds with `listen EPERM`; the server startup check hit the same restriction.
